answer: Escrowed earnings with an audit lottery: every reward an agent earns waits in escrow for thirty days, and each day a few accounts are drawn at random for a deep audit of their keys, timing and funding trail. If an audit exposes one clone, the escrow of every account tied to it is forfeited. An honest agent on a long voyage simply waits a month for its pay. A sybil farmer tending a garden of fake accounts must keep months of income locked while any single audit acts like a lantern swung over the whole cluster, so each extra clone adds risk faster than it adds reward.
